items.name: Formatter
items.summary: Handles the formatting of a CST and stores the context how the CST should be formatted (user preferences). The formatter is passed to the [Format] implementation of every node in the CST so that they can use it to format their children.

methods.name: context
methods.summary: Returns the Context specifying how to format the current CST

methods.name: context_mut
methods.summary: Returns a mutable reference to the context.

methods.name: fill
methods.signature: fn fill<'a>(&'a mut self) -> FillBuilder<'a, 'buf, Context>
methods.summary: Concatenates a list of [`crate::Format`] objects with spaces and line breaks to fit them on as few lines as possible. Each element introduces a conceptual group. The printer first tries to print the item in flat mode but then prints it in…

methods.name: group_id
methods.summary: Creates a new group id that is unique to this document. The passed debug name is used in the [`std::fmt::Debug`] of the document if this is a debug build. The name is unused for production builds and has no meaning on the equality of two g…

methods.name: intern_vec
methods.signature: fn intern_vec(&mut self, elements: Vec<FormatElement>) -> Option<FormatElement>

methods.name: join
methods.signature: fn join<'a>(&'a mut self) -> JoinBuilder<'a, 'buf, (), Context>
methods.summary: Joins multiple [Format] together without any separator

methods.name: join_with
methods.signature: fn join_with<'a, Joiner>(&'a mut self, joiner: Joiner) -> JoinBuilder<'a, 'buf, Joiner, Context> where Joiner: Format<Context>
methods.summary: Joins the objects by placing the specified separator between every two items.

methods.name: restore_state_snapshot
methods.summary: Restore the state of the formatter to a previous snapshot

methods.name: state_snapshot
methods.summary: Take a snapshot of the state of the formatter

methods.name: write_fmt
methods.signature: fn write_fmt(&mut self, arguments: Arguments<'_, Self::Context>) -> FormatResult<()>

items.name: FormatterSnapshot
items.summary: Snapshot of the formatter state  used to handle backtracking if errors are encountered in the formatting process and the formatter has to fallback to printing raw tokens
